Step: 1011 is not a leap year (divisible by 3, not by 4).  
From 11-16 backward:  
Oct 16 to Nov 16 = 31 days (Oct has 31).  
Sep 16 to Oct 16 = 30 days.  
Aug 16 to Sep 16 = 31 days.  
Jul 16 to Aug 16 = 31 days.  
Jun 16 to Jul 16 = 30 days.  
May 16 to Jun 16 = 31 days.  
Apr 16 to May 16 = 30 days.  
Mar 16 to Apr 16 = 31 days.  

Count days backward from Nov 16:  
Back 31 days → Oct 16 (224 - 31 = 193 left).  
Back 30 days → Sep 16 (193 - 30 = 163 left).  
Back 31 days → Aug 16 (163 - 31 = 132 left).  
Back 31 days → Jul 16 (132 - 31 = 101 left).  
Back 30 days → Jun 16 (101 - 30 = 71 left).  
Back 31 days → May 16 (71 - 31 = 40 left).  
Back 30 days → Apr 16 (40 - 30 = 10 left).  
Back 10 days from Apr 16 → Apr 6.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1011-04-06
